 Xiaomi unveils the HyperOS 4 update rollout schedule
 Post your comment

 Peter 
 04 November 2026 
 Xiaomi Android Firmware Updates 
 Xiaomi’s HyperOS 4 has a deeper integration with iOS – this includes easier sharing of photos, files, contacts and web pages with iPhone users. There are a lot of visual and performance improvements too. You can read more about HyperOS 4 here . Right now, only the Xiaomi 18 series trio runs v4, but soon older Xiaomi phones will get it too.
 Here is the detailed HyperOS 4 rollout schedule. The flagship models from 2025 and 2024 will get it soon – “early November” is the official time. They are not alone, however, and plenty of Redmi and Poco models from the last couple of years are on the list too, plus two tablets.
